Name: Revamped Dwarf Visuals (Featuring Facial Expressions)
Author: LemonWinner
Description:
Replaces all sprites with slightly altered versions
Replaces the dusty old singular [1] Dwarf portraits with six [6] shiny new ones! (one extra shiny!)


This is my first mod. I'm working on making a larger mod turning the Dwarf into the seventh bachelorette and decided to upload just the portraits and sprites if anyone wanted to download just them.

I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/226851450]HeadInTheClouds[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38898]Dwarf Portrait mod with emotions[/url] as a base!




If you want to use this as a base or inspiration for your own dwarf portraits, feel free to steal the emotions code (That I stole from HeadInTheClouds), remember that there aren't that many emotion triggers for the Dwarf since she usually only has the one portrait so you'll have to add those yourself (Feel free to take my triggers if it helps you) 

<3
